  "description": "Payzeep provides a range of financial services to individuals, merchants, banks, and government agencies. Our services are designed to help businesses and organizations streamline their payment processing and collection operations, providing a convenient and secure way for customers to pay for goods and services.

PayZeep has positioned itself to solve these problems by providing innovative products and services to help address the challenges of financial inclusion, cost of financial service delivery, and financial literacy. We provide secure and efficient payment processing and collection services across all payment channels to help increase financial service depth and touch the lives of people even at the grassroot.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Nodejs Backend Engineer&nbsp;

Job Locations: Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time

Position Summary


	The Node.js Backend Engineer builds and maintains backend services and APIs powering PayZeep&#39;s payment platform using Node.js.
	The Node.js Backend Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining scalable backend services, APIs, and microservices that power PayZeep digital financial products.


Key Responsibilities


	Design, build and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js.
	Write clean, tested, well-documented, maintainable code.
	Integrate with core banking, switching and third-party payment systems.
	Participate in code review, architecture discussions and sprint planning.
	Diagnose and resolve production incidents affecting backend services.
	Implement secure coding practices for payment-processing systems.
	Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability across production environments.
	Build services that support wallet management, transfers, collections, settlements, and reconciliation processes.
	Ensure transaction integrity and proper audit trails across financial operations.
	Implement secure coding standards and best practices in line with OWASP guidelines.
	Participate in vulnerability assessments, code reviews, and remediation initiatives.
	Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive measures for recurring issues.
	Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve system resilience and uptime.
	Implement logging, observability, and performance monitoring solutions.
	Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, QA Engineers, and Frontend Developers.
	Conduct peer code reviews and mentor junior engineers where applicable.


Qualifications


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (required).


Experience:


	Total Relevant Experience: 3-5 years of experience
	Fintech / Financial Services Experience: 3+ years building backend systems in fintech or a regulated environment preferred


Skills &amp; Competences:


	Strong Node.js/TypeScript and RESTful API development skills
	Experience with relational/NoSQL databases and message queues
	Understanding of secure coding practices (OWASP)
	Familiarity with containerization and CI/CD pipelines
	Experience with cloud-native application development.
	Advanced understanding of RESTful API design and development.
	Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
	Strong understanding of secure coding practices.
	Effective communication and collaboration skills.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent attention to detail and code quality.


Regulatory Considerations (Nigeria):


	Implement backend controls aligned with PCI-DSS secure-development requirements.
	Ensure data handling in backend services complies with the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA) 2023.


Application Closing Date
Not Specified.

How to Apply
Interested and qualified candidates should:

Nodejs Backend Engineer Job at Payzeep




        
    

        
        Payzeep provides a range of financial services to individuals, merchants, banks, and government agencies. Our services are designed to help businesses and organizations streamline their payment processing and collection operations, providing a convenient and secure way for customers to pay for goods and services.

PayZeep has positioned itself to solve these problems by providing innovative products and services to help address the challenges of financial inclusion, cost of financial service delivery, and financial literacy. We provide secure and efficient payment processing and collection services across all payment channels to help increase financial service depth and touch the lives of people even at the grassroot.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Nodejs Backend Engineer 

Job Locations: Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time

Position Summary


	The Node.js Backend Engineer builds and maintains backend services and APIs powering PayZeep's payment platform using Node.js.
	The Node.js Backend Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining scalable backend services, APIs, and microservices that power PayZeep digital financial products.


Key Responsibilities


	Design, build and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js.
	Write clean, tested, well-documented, maintainable code.
	Integrate with core banking, switching and third-party payment systems.
	Participate in code review, architecture discussions and sprint planning.
	Diagnose and resolve production incidents affecting backend services.
	Implement secure coding practices for payment-processing systems.
	Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability across production environments.
	Build services that support wallet management, transfers, collections, settlements, and reconciliation processes.
	Ensure transaction integrity and proper audit trails across financial operations.
	Implement secure coding standards and best practices in line with OWASP guidelines.
	Participate in vulnerability assessments, code reviews, and remediation initiatives.
	Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive measures for recurring issues.
	Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve system resilience and uptime.
	Implement logging, observability, and performance monitoring solutions.
	Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, QA Engineers, and Frontend Developers.
	Conduct peer code reviews and mentor junior engineers where applicable.


Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (required).


Experience:


	Total Relevant Experience: 3-5 years of experience
	Fintech / Financial Services Experience: 3+ years building backend systems in fintech or a regulated environment preferred


Skills & Competences:


	Strong Node.js/TypeScript and RESTful API development skills
	Experience with relational/NoSQL databases and message queues
	Understanding of secure coding practices (OWASP)
	Familiarity with containerization and CI/CD pipelines
	Experience with cloud-native application development.
	Advanced understanding of RESTful API design and development.
	Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
	Strong understanding of secure coding practices.
	Effective communication and collaboration skills.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent attention to detail and code quality.


Regulatory Considerations (Nigeria):


	Implement backend controls aligned with PCI-DSS secure-development requirements.
	Ensure data handling in backend services complies with the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA) 2023.


Application Closing Date
Not Specified.

Ads Specialist Job at Dynasty Africa




        
    

        
        Dynasty Africa is a leading full-service creative and marketing agency based in Lagos, Nigeria. Founded by CEO Dayo Adedeji, the agency has rapidly evolved from a Lagos-based digital startup into a pan-African powerhouse. It is widely recognized for professionalizing influencer marketing across the continent and elevating African creative talent onto the global stage.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Ads Specialist 

Job Location: Nigeria
Department: Comms
Reports to: Head of Communications / Head of Media

Role Summary
     

            
    




	The Ads Specialist plans, executes, and optimizes paid media campaigns across social and digital platforms to meet client performance goals, working closely with the wider creative team to bring advertising campaigns to life and reporting on ROI.


Key responsibilities


	Plan and set up paid social and digital ad campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)
	Manage ad budgets, bidding strategies, and audience targeting to meet KPIs
	Continuously test, optimize, and scale campaigns based on performance data
	Prepare regular performance reports with clear insights and recommendations
	Collaborate with the Design Lead and Media Specialist on ad creative and formats, ensuring creative is tailored to paid performance
	Partner with Account Management to align paid campaigns with broader client marketing objectives
	Stay current on ad platform updates, policy changes, and best practices
	Ensure all campaigns comply with platform advertising policies


Requirements & qualifications


	2-4+ years of hands-on paid media/performance marketing experience, ideally within a creative or marketing agency
	Proficiency with major ad platforms (Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, Google Ads)
	Strong analytical skills with experience in budget management and ROI reporting
	Understanding of audience targeting, funnel strategy, and creative testing
	Comfortable working with data and reporting tools (Excel/Sheets, dashboards)
	Detail-oriented with strong campaign management discipline.


Note


	Fields marked (*) are required
	Include your CV and a 30-second introductory video.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Fleet Officer&nbsp;

Role Overview
The Fleet officer will be


	Responsible for the setup, maintenance, refurbishment, quality assurance, and security of the fleet within their jurisdiction, ensuring all MAX assets receive routine maintenance and that&nbsp;vehicle refurbishment is completed within approved time and cost limits while maintaining the required quality standards


Key Responsibilities


	Test vehicles before maintenance to ascertain the level of repair to be carried out
	Follow up the process of repair to ensure that spare parts appropriated for maintenance work is utilized judiciously.
	Work with the vehicle maintenance manager to improve on checklists and maintenance routines
	Periodically visit Authorized Service Workshops to confirm that maintenance work is carried out according to MAX routines and standards.
	Inspect/Test Vehicles after maintenance to ensure that the needed repairs are carried out.


Vehicle Refurbishment:


	Support in the assessment of vehicles using the pre-assessment checklist before refurbishment is carried out to ascertain the level of damage
	Inspect spare parts which are to be used for refurbishment purposes to ensure it meets the requirements
	Inspect/Test vehicles after refurbishment using the post-assessment checklist to confirm the vehicles are refurbished to set standards
	Guide technicians on maintenance best practices


Administrative Function:


	Ensure job cards are filled out for every vehicle brought into the facility for maintenance/refurbishment.
	Conduct frequent training of technicians


Requirements

	Strong interpersonal and communication(written and oral) skills
	Good understanding of Inventory Control principles and practices
	Proficient in MS Office/Google Workspace
	Good understanding of fleet management
	Critical and Analytical thinking Accuracy and Attention to detail
	Confidentiality and Thoroughness.


Education:


	Minimum of OND in any Engineering discipline.
	2 Years cognate experience as a vehicle technician or 2 years experience in fleet management
	Mechanical Engineering is preferred

Fleet Officer Job at Max Drive




        
    

        
        Max Drive - We are a team of passionate people and a leading technology-enabled company driven by a vision to solve the mobility challenges in Africa. We want to get people and goods to their destinations hitch-free. It is personal for us because we understand the frustration of epileptic transportation. We are making mobility safe, affordable, accessible, and sustainable through the deployment of high-performance technologies and operators.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Fleet Officer 

Job Location: Lagos

Role Overview
The Fleet officer will be
     

            
    




	Responsible for the setup, maintenance, refurbishment, quality assurance, and security of the fleet within their jurisdiction, ensuring all MAX assets receive routine maintenance and that vehicle refurbishment is completed within approved time and cost limits while maintaining the required quality standards


Key Responsibilities


	Test vehicles before maintenance to ascertain the level of repair to be carried out
	Follow up the process of repair to ensure that spare parts appropriated for maintenance work is utilized judiciously.
	Work with the vehicle maintenance manager to improve on checklists and maintenance routines
	Periodically visit Authorized Service Workshops to confirm that maintenance work is carried out according to MAX routines and standards.
	Inspect/Test Vehicles after maintenance to ensure that the needed repairs are carried out.


Vehicle Refurbishment:


	Support in the assessment of vehicles using the pre-assessment checklist before refurbishment is carried out to ascertain the level of damage
	Inspect spare parts which are to be used for refurbishment purposes to ensure it meets the requirements
	Inspect/Test vehicles after refurbishment using the post-assessment checklist to confirm the vehicles are refurbished to set standards
	Guide technicians on maintenance best practices


Administrative Function:


	Ensure job cards are filled out for every vehicle brought into the facility for maintenance/refurbishment.
	Conduct frequent training of technicians


Requirements
Skills & Competencies: 


	Strong interpersonal and communication(written and oral) skills
	Good understanding of Inventory Control principles and practices
	Proficient in MS Office/Google Workspace
	Good understanding of fleet management
	Critical and Analytical thinking Accuracy and Attention to detail
	Confidentiality and Thoroughness.


Education:


	Minimum of OND in any Engineering discipline.
	2 Years cognate experience as a vehicle technician or 2 years experience in fleet management
	Mechanical Engineering is preferred
